title: IPIP-NEO-120: official IPIP key wording
status: Published public-domain Big Five item set; local presentation and report require evaluation in intended audience.

provenance.publication: Johnson, J. A. (2014). Measuring thirty facets of the Five Factor Model with a 120-item public domain inventory: Development of the IPIP-NEO-120. Journal of Research in Personality, 51, 78–89.
provenance.textHandling: Verbatim item text from official IPIP key; HTML whitespace trimmed. No item paraphrases. Published item numbers restored independently from Johnson Table 1.

knownDiscrepancies.officialKeyText: Believe that there is no absolute right and wrong.
knownDiscrepancies.publicationText: Believe that there is no absolute right or wrong.
knownDiscrepancies.decision: Use official IPIP website wording consistently; lock this as the bank version. Norm matching must audit this variant.

administration.order: Ascending publishedItemNumber; save order with the attempt.
administration.instructions: Describe yourself as you generally are now, across your life, rather than only at work. Choose how accurately each statement describes you. There are no right or wrong answers. You may skip a statement.
administration.instructionsStatus: Product-authored administration text; not a quotation of the original instructions. Evaluate comprehension and comparability in pilot.

scoring.facetAggregation: sum of the four keyed items
scoring.domainAggregation: sum of all 24 keyed items in the domain
scoring.optionalPompLabel: Position on the possible score range, not a percentile
scoring.missingnessPolicy: Allow skips. Score a facet only when all 4 responses are present and a domain only when all 24 responses are present. Otherwise return null with status incomplete and answered/required counts. Still show all complete scales.
scoring.missingnessPolicyStatus: Conservative product policy, not a published IPIP missingness rule.
scoring.higherNMeans: More self-reported negative emotionality, not emotional stability.
scoring.weights: Equal item weights. No AI, adaptive weighting, demographic adjustment, or ipsatization.

items.text: Believe in the importance of art.
Use others for my own ends.

items.contentNote: Historical facet label is Depression. This is not a clinical depression screen or diagnosis.

items.text: Find it difficult to approach others.
Believe that I am better than others.
Tend to vote for liberal political candidates.
items.contentNote: Contains culture-dependent political or moral-value wording. Permit skip; do not infer political identity.

items.text: Believe that others have good intentions.
Talk to a lot of different people at parties.
See beauty in things that others might not notice.
Often forget to put things back in their proper place.

items.contentNote: Historical facet label is Depression. This is not a clinical depression screen or diagnosis.

items.text: Am afraid to draw attention to myself.
Prefer to stick with things that I know.
Do more than what's expected of me.
Believe that there is no absolute right and wrong.
items.contentNote: Contains culture-dependent political or moral-value wording. Permit skip; do not infer political identity.
items.provenanceNote: Current official IPIP key uses 'right and wrong'; Johnson (2014), Table 1 uses 'right or wrong'. This bank retains the current official-key wording and records the discrepancy.

items.text: Feel sympathy for those who are worse off than myself.
Leave a mess in my room.
Am often down in the dumps.
